hooks.name: Run Tests Before Push
hooks.description: Runs all vitest unit tests before any git push. Blocks the push if tests fail (exit 2).

action.command: $input = $null; try { $input = $args[0] | ConvertFrom-Json } catch {}; $cmd = $input?.tool_input?.command; if ($cmd -match "git push") { $nodeDir = "C:\Users\jonathan.tsilva\AppData\Local\nvm\v18.20.8"; $env:PATH = "$nodeDir;$env:PATH"; Push-Location "c:\Users\jonathan.tsilva\Documents\Projetos\FitPlan App\app-treino"; $result = & "$nodeDir\npx.cmd" vitest run 2>&1; Pop-Location; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error "Tests failed. Fix before pushing.`n$result"; exit 2 } }
